name: notion
summary: Notion's hosted MCP server (search, read and edit pages and databases) with browser sign-in

connect.identity: your Notion account and the workspace you pick at sign-in

notes: Sign in with your Notion account in the browser and choose the workspace: lotr setup notion. The server's discovery document advertises dynamic client registration.
OAuth is the only documented method for the hosted server; non-interactive authorization is not available yet. scopes is left empty: the discovery document lists only 'default'.
Access is limited to what your Notion account can see in the chosen workspace. Workspace owners manage MCP client access under Settings > Connections; the docs state no plan requirement.
Alternative, local: @notionhq/notion-mcp-server (stdio, integration token). Notion says it is no longer actively maintained and calls it a last resort.
Legacy SSE URL https://mcp.notion.com/sse exists as a fallback; not used here.
The mcp-oauth kind takes no connect.policy; the gateway classes risky tool names (delete, send) as consent by itself.
Notion's deleting tools (notion-delete-pages, notion-delete-databases) move items to Trash.
